title: Lockup: Colorado: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E5 — Pain
One reality of prison is that there's never a shortage of pain, and at the Limon Correctional Facility in Colorado, there's enough left over for the visitors as well; drama unfolds as a father and son try to reconcile a violent past.

title: Lockup: Grand Rapids: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E3 — Jailing
A gangbanger squares off with his victim's family in court and with another inmate inside the jail; the Kent County Jail staff must deal with a former colleague gone bad.

title: Lockup: Grand Rapids: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E4 — And Baby Makes Three?
Behind the razor wire topped fences and brick walls of the Kent County Jail an inmate worker deals with the pressure of trying to create the jail's most popular dish; a pair of incarcerated lovers might end up having another mouth to feed.

title: Lockup: Corcoran: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E3 — Hugs Not Drugs
Inmates have been dreaming up new ways to smuggle in contraband since Corcoran opened its doors in 1988; whether in the form of drugs or weapons, it's always a race against time for prison officials to find the banned items before it's too late.

title: Lockup: Corcoran: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E6 — Road to Redemption
Bad decisions have landed thousands of inmates in Corcoran; once in prison, they've got two choices, do their time and go home or become even more destructive on the inside; the path they choose could determine the difference between life and death.

title: Lockup: Cleveland: Extended Stay
description:
S16 E6 — Checkmate
The tenth floor of Cuyahoga County Correction Center contains the Special Response Team, or SERT, a tactical unit trained in the use of riot gear, non-lethal weapons and controlling high-risk inmates.

title: Lockup: Raw
description:
S6 E5 — The Little Things
Jail stays are getting longer and many inmates have very little, leading to violence erupting over any perceived slight, especially if it involves food.

title: Lockup: Raw
description:
S5 E6 — No Boys Allowed
A look at female inmates that start off socializing, but end up creating a lot drama for the staff.

title: Lockup: Cincinnati: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E6 — Dead Run
A heroin addict must choose between the lifestyle she craves and the young son she has left behind; another seasoned female inmate is transferred back to the jail from state prison, but she suddenly finds herself on the wrong end of a fist.
